text:
Ava (People Ops): FYI we're publishing a short handbook update Friday 10:00 PT: 'Home-office & travel stipend' — changes: updated caps, cleareligibility for part-timers, and contractor callouts. Please flag blockers. :loudspeaker:

Ravi (Payroll): If caps change, do we need a payroll mapping? When will new amounts hit pay runs?

Ava (People Ops): New caps take effect with the May payroll. We'll provide a CSV with ack_version; no mid-month retro pay.

Marta (Legal): Adding EU/UK clause for contractor treatment and tax note. Will post a short addendum by EOD.

Lina (EMEA Ops): Translations will take ~3 business days. Recommend publish master now and add localized addenda when ready.

Owen (Comp): I'll post the country table tomorrow (taxable? gross/net?) and mark exceptions.

Ava (People Ops): Plan: publish master + "localized addendum coming" banner. Require a 4-min employee micro-cert and a 1-page manager checklist. Completion due by May 12.

ops-bot: Managers will receive automated DMs on publish and nudges at day 3 and day 9. Use `/ops-bot export-acks --since 2026-05-01 --format csv`.

Ravi (Payroll): Requesting CSV headers: employee_id, name, email, region, employment_type, stipend_amount, ack_version, ack_ts. Include `notes` for overrides?

Ava (People Ops): Yes add `notes`. Also include `contractor_flag` column.

Owen (Comp): Reimbursements still require receipts; stipends do not. Adding FAQ blurb.

Marta (Legal): Contractor pointer: "Contractors: see your contract or contact ops@redwood.com" added.

Lina (EMEA Ops): No blockers from EMEA.

Ravi (Payroll): I'll validate the CSV mapping once comp table is pasted. Confirming by Thursday.

Ava (People Ops): Thanks — action items: (1) publish master Fri 10:00 PT, (2) comp posts table tomorrow, (3) legal addenda done EOD, (4) payroll validates CSV by Thu, (5) micro-cert + manager checklist live on publish. Any concerns?

Owen (Comp): All good here.

Marta (Legal): All set.

ops-bot: Publish scheduled. Weekly ack summary will post to #people-ops on Mondays. :white_check_mark:

Ava (People Ops): I'll share the prod link and manager TL;DR after publish.
